description: Central Province Provincial Council - Amendment to the Subjects of the Ministries in Central Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette exclusively details structural and administrative changes to the ministries of the Central Province, specifically amending the subjects (portfolios and responsibilities) assigned to them. While it is issued by the named Governor, the content itself does not focus on his appointment or any other personnel change. The core information is the reassignment of functions and duties between ministries, with no named individuals being appointed to these portfolios. This fits the definition of an Organisational Gazette (Type 1).
